title: AaveFamily
tagline: Do you want to connect your wallet, and see market data ? Well we've got the platform for you !!
description: For a beginner-friendly project using Voiceflow and Aave APIs, focusing on chat/text interactions, a simple "Crypto Market Update" assistant. This tool can provide users with the latest information on cryptocurrency prices, lending and borrowing rates, and other relevant market data from Aave. The assistant can be designed to answer user queries about specific cryptocurrencies or general market conditions, using data fetched from Aave's API. This approach allows you to familiarize yourself with both Voiceflow and Aave's API without delving into complex financial transactions or advice.
how_its_made: We used Voiceflow for the chatbot, ConnectKit from Family for the connect wallet button, and Aave api for the market data. I wish we could've integrated more but my cat got really sick during this hackathon all week. Our original idea was to develop a tool that analyses the risk profile of different lending or borrowing options available on Aave, helping users to make informed decisions.
